授業概要
歯・顎・顔面の構造や機能について、画像診断学的手法により知識や理解を深め、病態の解明や生体情報の解析を行う。さらに、画像工学や放射線利用による生体分析の研究を行う。
To deepen knowledge and understanding of the structures and functions in the oral and maxillofacial region by diagnostic imaging techniques, and to elucidate the pathophysiology, and analyze biological information. In addition, to conduct research on bioanalysis using image engineering and radiation.
